09.03.05.12 A mere scheme or rule or method of performing mental act or 
method of playing game is not an invention. 
A mere scheme or rule or method of performing mental act or 
method of playing game, are excluded from patentability, because they 
are considered as outcome of mere mental process. For example, 
a) Method of playing chess. 
b) Method of teaching. 
c) Method of learning.
